# SimasiaAI

> SimasiaAI (Σημασία-ΑΙ Ι.Κ.Ε., Athens, Greece) is a Greek AI company with a social-impact focus. Its one product, fλow (also written "flow"), is an AI assistant + CRM for people who care for others: NGOs, patient associations, disability services, doctors, practices, polyclinics and clinics in Greece and Cyprus. fλow is "dialogue, action and record, in one flow": three parts that work alone or together. DialogosAI (dialogue) is the AI assistant that answers patients, beneficiaries, members and families 24/7 on the website, Viber and WhatsApp, only from approved sources with citations, says when it doesn't know and sends urgent cases to a human. PraxisAI (action) is the CRM with agentic actions (it proposes and executes, a human approves what goes out): member registry, beneficiary files and patient records, tasks with deadlines, protocol book with automatic numbers, deadline reminders 60/30/7 days ahead, appointment confirmations, shift handovers, document scanning (OCR). MetronAI (record) records every contact and analyses it: communication statistics, what people ask and what is missing, social-impact reports for sponsors, a monthly accuracy test. EU AI Act and GDPR compliant, data in the EU. It never gives medical advice. NGOs and associations pay per part, cheaper together (DialogosAI or PraxisAI €119/month, MetronAI €89/month, all three €249/month, plus onboarding); 60-day trial for €199. Clinics: the whole fλow from €199/month (€149 annual), live in 48 hours or free. Motto: «Μέτρο μας ο Άνθρωπος» (The human is our measure).

Key facts: live with Κάπα3 («Μυρτώ», DialogosAI + MetronAI), ΠΟΑμΣΚΠ («ΣΚΠ-i», Multiple Sclerosis, DialogosAI) and Ήρωες της BPAN («BPAN Companion», DialogosAI in 60 languages); Perfectaki Able (DialogosAI for accessible education) is being built. Pharma/CSR sponsors can fund fλow for organisations. Contact: contact@simasiaai.gr.

## Product

- [fλow](https://www.simasiaai.gr/flow): the product page: DialogosAI, PraxisAI and MetronAI with live demos of all three and who it is for
- [Go with the fλow](https://www.simasiaai.gr/go): a few questions about your day design a first fλow; adjust parts and features, add your own requests, see the time that comes back, leave your email and receive the priced offer as a PDF, or book a 30-minute call (/go#book). Prices are not published on the site.
- [fλow platform](https://www.simasiaai.gr/platform): the future fλow client sign-in (coming soon)
